office_does: Pacific County PUD No. 2 is the county's public electric utility; its three commissioners, elected county-wide for six-year terms, set rates and policy and oversee the general manager.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Commissioner Pam Hickey, first elected in 2020, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: PUD commissioner since 2020 and former Chinook Water District office manager; the only candidate.
highlights: Says rates are lower than neighboring utilities and the PUD is debt free [S1]
Cites north county broadband and a 20-year Bonneville power contract [S1]
Donates 10% of her base salary toward neighbors' utility bills [S1]
